name: glassbox-hud
description: X-Ray Diagnostic HUD for Vibe Coding — turn raw AI errors & diffs into visual information-design cards

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@glassbox/core && npm run build --workspace=@glassbox/cli && npm run build --workspace=@glassbox/sidecar && npm run build --workspace=@glassbox/hud
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@glassbox/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@glassbox/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace=@glassbox/ui && npm run typecheck --workspace=@glassbox/sidecar && npm run typecheck --workspace=@glassbox/hud
